Available at: http://www.britishinfectionsociety.org/documents/ MeningitisAlgorithm03.pdf (accessed 18/08/08) Mouth infections Infections of the mouth include those of dental origin such as dental caries, abscesses, gingivitis, and periodontal in- fections, and those without a dental origin. Infections aris- ing in the nasal cavity, middle ear, oropharynx, and para- nasal sinuses can also affect the oral cavity. Emphasis has shifted from treatment to prevention of oral diseases.1 This discussion deals mainly with infections of dental origin.
